previousBulletins: The Ochre Hand and the Stonecutter Raiders are at war again, if they ever stopped. Word is that an Ochre Hand camp lost three of its people to a night raid.
The Weir Federation has put a bounty on Stonecutter leaders. The sum is generous, the leaders are well armed, and I expect the bounty will go unclaimed for some time.
